text: Athlete wants conditioning to get a proper warm-up like the heavy lifts. Finisher metcons in lifting sessions start with item set metcon_ramp (templates updated). Engine test days (bike/row/ski) add item set engine_test_ramp at the end of the warm-up, identical at every retest: the code-generated test-day template does not add it yet, so add it when designing test days. Proposal 2026-11-21-config-change-1.
